name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for foggy window repair in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for foggy window repair in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for foggy window repair in the Bay Area, look for companies with specific experience in insulated glass unit (IGU) replacement or repair. Check for proper licensing and insurance for general contractors in California. Read customer reviews and ask for references. Obtain multiple detailed quotes to compare services and pricing. A reliable contractor should offer a clear warranty on their work and be knowledgeable about the types of windows common in the Bay Area, such as those that might be exposed to coastal conditions in Pacifica or Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a reliable Bay Area foggy window repair contractor by verifying licensing and insurance, checking reviews, asking for references, comparing multiple quotes, and ensuring they offer a warranty on their work.
